steps.prompt: What is something you know so well you could teach it to a younger student?

cards.title: Five paragraphs that explain
cards.body: Introduction (hook, background, a thesis naming three parts) → three body paragraphs, one per part, with facts and examples → a conclusion that restates and leaves a final thought.

cards.title: Plan, then write
cards.body: Use the outline builder to plan each part, then press “Start my essay from the outline” to turn your plan into paragraphs. Build each paragraph out into full sentences.

cards.title: Watch the essay map
cards.body: The essay map marks your hook, thesis, topic sentences, evidence and conclusion as you write. Fix every ! before you submit.

prompts: Which body paragraph was easiest to write? Which was hardest?
What did you change after checking the essay map?
